description: Generate wallet trust fact profiles for up to 10 wallets in a single request. Shared block fetches make this faster than sequential calls. Each wallet gets an independently signed profile with its own TRST-XXXXX ID. Supports partial success: failed wallets get error entries while successful ones return full profiles. Costs 3 credits per successful wallet (6 with proof: 'merkle'); credits are charged only for successful profiles. A wallet whose reads did not complete gets an error entry and no signed profile: retry that wallet, and never treat the entry as a no.

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle storage proofs on all wallets (6 credits/wallet).

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address. Adds the Bitcoin dimension.

solanaWallet.description: Solana wallet address (base58). Adds the Solana dimension.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). Lets the rows on Stellar evaluate; adds no dimension.

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex). Lets the rows on Sui evaluate; adds no dimension.

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed). Adds the Tron dimension.

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). Adds the XRPL dimension.
